style.prompt: Create a polished square Instagram feed promotional graphic announcing a discount. Typography-led contemporary retail design, striking cobalt blue background with warm cream typography and a simple lime accent, generous margins, crisp high contrast, excellent mobile legibility. Oversized bold '20% OFF' headline, followed by a centered middle dot separator and smaller 'This weekend only' subheading. The exact text, in reading order, must be: "20% OFF · This weekend only". No other words, no logos, no invented brand, no products. Stylish balanced editorial layout with subtle geometric accents.
